tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa las: rig 'dzin byin 'beb bzhugs so:1$0000300

dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yi phrin las nyid: sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub kun gyi gter: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: sgrub chen dkyil 'khor rgyan la sogs: sngon 'gro'i rim pa yongs rdzogs nas: rnal 'byor rnams ni chas su zhugs: spos dud btang zhing sha chen bsreg: de la bskor zhing rol mo bsgrag: dkyil 'khor sman gyi pho brang nas: byin chen dbab pa 'di skad do: hūm̐: dpal ldan nub phyogs u rgyan yul: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas byin phob cig: he ru ka yi gnas bcu mchog: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: yon tan sna tshogs dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma saṃ bhas byin phob cig: grong khyer yangs pa can gyi gnas: rā ga ra ti'i gnas mchog tu: thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub brnyes: blo ldan mchog sred byin phob cig: shar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas: dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma rgyal pos byin= mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa'i drung: so sa gling gi dur khrod du: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: nyi ma 'od zer byin= yul ni rgya gar shar gyi phyogs: za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su: bdud 'dul drag po'i dngos grub brnyes: shākya seng ges byin phob cig: dbus 'gyur ma ga dha yi yul: rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog tu: mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: seng ge sgra sgrog byin= yul ni gangs can bod kyi yul: stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub tu: dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: rdo rje gro lod byin= yul ni rgya nag shar phyogs yul: ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas mchog tu: yon tan bdud rtsi'i dngos grub brnyes: bi ma mi tras byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: 'jam dpal sku yi dngos grub brnyes:

sangs rgyas ye shes byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: mchims phu bre gu'i dge 'u nas: pad+ma gsung gi dngos grub brnyes: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: mkhar chu gsang ba'i dbang phug tu: yang dag thugs kyi dngos grub brnyes: nam mkha'i snying pos byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: yar lung shel gyi brag phug tu: bdud rtsi sman gyi dngos grub brnyes: gnyags chen dzñā nas byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: nai ring seng ge'i rdzong gsum nas: phrin las phur pa'i dngos grub brnyes: mkhar chen mtsho rgyal byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: sham po gangs kyi rwa ba nas: rbod gtong ma mo'i dngos grub brnyes: dpal gyi ye shes byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: gnam mtsho sngags kyi sgrub gnas nas: dregs pa kun 'dul dngos grub brnyes: rlangs chen dpal seng byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: g.ya' ma lung gi dben gnas nas: drag sngags mthu yi dngos grub brnyes: bai ro tsa nas byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum nas: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dngos grub brnyes: chos rgyal chen pos byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: lhun grub dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'dus: zhi khro'i lha tshogs byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas: bar chad sel zhing phrin las sgrub: ma mo mkha' 'gros byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: dpal chen he ru ka yi gnas bcu nas: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: ke'u seng dbang phyug byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: bka' 'dus gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dgra bgegs 'joms shing bar chad sel: chos skyong srung mas byin= byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir:

sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: bsnyen sgrub gzhung bzhin sgrub lags na: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du: dur khrod gnas brgyad la sogs nas: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas: rgyan dang cod pan si li li: bshug glu rol mo ti ri ri: nam mkha' khyab pa'i gar mdzad cing: gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur la: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: gu ru dhe wa dha ki nī sarba sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ: dza dza: pheṃ pheṃ: ā be sha ya a ā: zhes rol mo rnams kyi skabs su byin dbab cing dkyil 'khor bskor: mda' dar dang me long la sogs pa yang g.yab bo: slob dpon gyi gsung bzhin bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas yi ger bkod pa'o: sa ma ya: kha thaṃ: rgya rgya rgya: : sprul sku rat+na gling pas dmyal smad dge ri brag nas gdan drangs pa'o: maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
